subject: Fwd: Aurora Financial — URGENT SOC 2 Type II report request (under NDA) + artifact list
body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Fwd: Aurora Financial — URGENT SOC 2 Type II report request (under NDA) + artifact list

Aisha/Olga/Daniel — escalating given timeline.

Aurora Financial just came back that procurement won’t advance without the SOC 2 Type II report + a couple of supporting artifacts, and they’re asking for turnaround by Monday 2/10 EOD.

Can we confirm:
1) We can share the full SOC 2 Type II report under mutual NDA (or their NDA) and
2) What response SLA we can commit to once NDA is executed?

Attached is their artifact list (spreadsheet) + our latest mutual NDA draft that Legal has been using for similar requests.

Thanks,
Stephanie

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Readiness Lead
Redwood Inference


---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Megan Walsh <mwalsh@aurorafinancial.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 8:41 AM PST
Subject: Aurora Financial — SOC 2 Type II report request + security artifacts
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <rpatel@aurorafinancial.com>

Hi Stephanie,

Per our internal security review, we need the following to proceed to contract review:

1. Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
2. Management response / corrective action plan for any exceptions (if applicable)
3. A copy of your incident response policy overview (high level is fine)
4. Summary of encryption (in transit/at rest) and key management options
5. Description of audit logging and export capability (fields and retention)

We can receive the SOC 2 report under NDA. Our preference is mutual NDA; if you have a standard form please send.

Timing: our procurement gate is Monday (2/10) end of day.

Thanks,
Megan Walsh
Vendor Risk Manager
Aurora Financial
(415) 555-0184



From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 9:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora Financial — URGENT SOC 2 Type II report request (under NDA) + artifact list

Olga/Daniel — can you confirm what we can commit to on timing here?

Proposed response to field:
- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under an executed NDA.
- Once NDA is fully executed, standard SLA is 2 business days; for Aurora we’ll target end of day Monday given the urgency.

Also, please advise if we have a current “management response” package ready to share (if no exceptions, we should say “no exceptions noted” rather than “clean”).

For the other items (IR overview, encryption/KMS, audit logging/export + retention), can we point to customer-facing one-pagers + docs links instead of sending internal policy docs?

If there are any constraints (e.g., only via secure portal, watermarking), call them out.

-Aisha


From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 10:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora Financial — URGENT SOC 2 Type II report request (under NDA) + artifact list

Confirmed:

1) SOC 2 Type II report: shareable under executed NDA only. We should route through the evidence request workflow (even if expedited) so we have an audit trail.

2) SLA language: please don’t “commit” to EOD Monday in writing unless we’re sure NDA will be executed today. We can say:
   - “Upon receipt of a fully executed NDA, we typically provide the SOC 2 report within 2 business days.”
   - “Given your timeline, we will prioritize this request and aim to turn it around as quickly as possible.”

3) “Management response / CAP”: if there are any noted exceptions in the report, the management response is included in the report package. We should not separately send internal remediation trackers.

4) For IR policy: we can provide a high-level incident response overview / summary statement, not the full internal IR plan.

5) Encryption/KMS and audit logging: preferred to send the approved one-pagers / docs links (customer-facing), not internal architecture docs.

Daniel can confirm the latest report package version and the secure delivery method.

Olga

Olga Petrov
GRC Lead
Redwood Inference


From: Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 10:37 AM PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora Financial — URGENT SOC 2 Type II report request (under NDA) + artifact list

+1 to Olga’s guidance.

Operationally:
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report package is ready in the restricted evidence repository.
- Delivery: we can provide via a time-bound secure link (preferred) once NDA is executed and the requester is verified.
- Watermarking: report is already watermarked; we should not remove.

If Aurora executes the mutual NDA today, we can likely deliver the SOC 2 report tomorrow (Sunday) since this is a blocker, but I’d rather keep the written promise at “2 business days” and then overdeliver.

For the rest of the artifact list, we can attach:
- IR overview (approved 1-pager)
- Encryption/KMS one-pager
- Audit logging overview (customer-facing) + export options docs

If Marketing has not finalized the new one-pagers yet, we can use the current approved versions from Confluence.

-Daniel

Daniel Carter
Compliance Evidence Reviewer
Redwood Inference


From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 11:04 AM PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora Financial — URGENT SOC 2 Type II report request (under NDA) + artifact list

Steph/Markus — recommended response to Aurora (approved language):

- We can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report under a fully executed NDA.
- Upon receipt of an executed NDA, our standard turnaround is within 2 business days; we will prioritize Aurora’s request due to your stated timeline.
- For the additional items, we will provide customer-facing summaries/one-pagers for incident response overview, encryption/key management, and audit logging/export/retention.

Do NOT:
- promise EOD Monday explicitly
- describe the report as “clean”
- send internal IR plan or internal remediation trackers

Daniel/Olga will coordinate fulfillment once NDA is signed.

-Aisha


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Walsh <mwalsh@aurorafinancial.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <rpatel@aurorafinancial.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 3:28 PM PST
Subject: Re: Aurora Financial — SOC 2 Type II report request + security artifacts
Attachments: AuroraFinancial_Redwood_MutualNDA_draft_v3.pdf, AuroraFinancial_Security_Artifact_Request_List.xlsx

Hi Megan,

Thanks — we can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report under a fully executed NDA.

Attached is our standard mutual NDA for review. Once we have a fully executed NDA, our typical turnaround to share the SOC 2 report is within 2 business days, and we’ll prioritize Aurora’s request given your Monday timeline.

In parallel, we can also provide customer-facing summaries for:
- Incident response (high-level overview)
- Encryption in transit/at rest + key management options
- Audit logging, export destinations, and retention controls

Markus (cc’d) will coordinate the rest of the artifacts and the secure delivery of the SOC 2 report once NDA is in place.

Best,
Stephanie

Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Readiness Lead | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com


(Internal note: once NDA is executed, route fulfillment through the evidence request workflow and log under SUP-28421.)
